The Menders' Stead is a subzone in the center of Western Plaguelands that is inhabited by the Cenarion Circle and Argent Crusade, who are cleansing the area.

The Memorial to Sully Balloo is a memorial built by Grand Mason Marblesten, as ordered by Magni Bronzebeard. It was erected in honor to the fallen soldier Sully Balloo, who died during the Thandol Span tragedy.

Tinkers hove long sought methods to help those soldiers haunted by their war experiences. The most methods attempt to erase the memories of those events altogether. Unfortunately, none have yet managed to achieve the desired degree of precision that would allow the removal of only selected memories. However, tinkers have managed to develop a machine that can erase the most recent memories of those it is used upon: the memory scrubber. The memory scrubber is a chair attached to a large trunk full of machinery. The target of the device sits on the chair and places the device's helmet onto her head. Meng the Demented was an emperor of the mogu empire. According to the Repository in the Mogu'shan Vaults, he was the most foul and maniacal ruler to ever abuse the imperial throne. An obscure passage in an ancient text suggested that when Meng the Demented lost his balance, he lost his mind.

Memory of the Alliance is located in the Summer Fields in Vale of Eternal Blossoms. Interacting with it replays the Alliance ending cutscene for the Siege of Orgrimmar raid.

Memories of Arthas are echoes of Arthas Menethil the Lich King that spawn from the Blades of the Fallen Prince in several locations around the Broken Isles. When interacted with, they speak a few cryptic lines to the death knight and then fade from view.
The Memory of Ra-den appears during The Codex of Ra in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

Mended Shal'dorei Silk is provided as an objective for Return the Filter. Originally torn, Leyweaver Erenyi mended it, and it was brought to Deucus Valdera who used it as a filter for his alchemy table.
Mender Jessara is a nightborne located at the Orgrimmar Embassy in Orgrimmar. An Orgrimmar Bruiser is faking an injury because he's in love with her.

Memories are images conjured from Theryn's mind in Scenes from a Memory.
